item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description: Choose models per conversation using the Hermes server catalog and confirmation prompts. Leading-aligned tool output, inline thinking, and Stop in the composer. Existing old-chat editing still awaits the Hermes backend fix.

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description: Fix 404 errors when opening or deleting empty chats before their first message. Clean up empty-chat connections and distinguish a missing chat from saved history the Hermes runtime refuses to edit. Older history may still require backend migration.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description: Fix chat deletion and renaming with current Hermes backends. Update session-edit compatibility checks and prevent duplicate edits after connection failures.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description: Klaudimero name and original logo restored. Sign in to your configurable Hermes dashboard with username and password or a dashboard access token. Agent profiles are discovered from the server and remain separate from saved connections. Updated streaming chat, session resume, stop, and one-time approvals. Universal Intel and Apple Silicon build.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description: First native Hermes client for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Klaudimero-inspired Today and chat views, configurable agent profiles, streaming Markdown replies, tool activity, approvals, and Keychain credentials. Requires the Hermes API server. Internal Apple Development signing with hardened runtime; not notarized.
